description: Visual QA of the corrected Groupoids, Simplicial Methods, and Derived Categories of Spaces chapters: complete layout overview plus detailed inspection of every R48 and reviewed Illusie correction page.

scope.review_scope: All 216 pages received a contact-sheet layout overview. All 24 correction pages received direct full-page high-resolution inspection. This is visual QA, not a new whole-chapter mathematical proof audit.

render_protocol.contact_sheets: Ordered 4-by-4 sheets; all page tiles inspected for layout.
render_protocol.high_resolution_evidence_reused: The unchanged previously inspected 24-page renders were retained and their source/PDF/image identities rechecked; no new TeX build or high-resolution rerender was used.
render_protocol.text_extraction_role: Locator corroboration only; never substituted for actual image inspection.
render_protocol.mapping_detail: Exact source intervals and rebased manifest operations were located through fresh AUX labels, actual PDF named destinations and rendered content. No SyncTeX sidecar was generated.

full_page_overview_inspections.inspection_scope: Complete page-layout overview, not word-by-word mathematical verification.

sheets.observation: Pages 1-16: title and contents align within the margins; running heads and page numbers remain consistent. Group-scheme examples, displayed equations, commutative diagrams, lemma/proof spacing and section changes have no gross overlap or page-edge clipping. Every tile contains the expected distinct page.

Pages 17-32: the abelian-variety, actions, homogeneous-space and equivariant-sheaf sections flow regularly. Larger diagrams on pages 24 and 30-32 remain inside the text block. Footnotes and bottom-of-page continuations fit. No blank page, displaced page block, or visible clipped diagram was seen.

Pages 33-48: limits/colimits, stabilizers, restrictions, invariants and quotient sections maintain consistent margins and heading spacing. The several multi-arrow diagrams retain visible surrounding whitespace. Dense pages 37 and 48 have intact lower edges. No gross layout defect was seen.

Pages 49-60: finite-flat groupoid and descent arguments keep their displays and diagrams within the page body. The chapter-navigation list on pages 58-60 changes to two columns cleanly; the short reference list on page 60 is intentional content, not a missing or blank page. No overview-level clipping or overlap was seen.

full_page_overview_inspections.inspection_scope: Complete page-layout overview, not word-by-word mathematical verification.

sheets.observation: Pages 1-16: title/contents, section headings and proof blocks show consistent margins and running headers. The ordinal and simplicial diagrams fit their columns without cropping, collisions or missing render areas. No blank or corrupted page observed.

Pages 17-32: arrow diagrams, stacked identities, fibre-product diagrams and dense proof pages remain within margins. Headers and page numbers continue consistently; no broken page, visible overflow, diagram collision or blank render observed.

Pages 33-48: algebraic and Dold-Kan displays, diagrams and footnotes have consistent text-column geometry. Long equations and the relative-homotopy section opening fit the page. No layout damage, clipped area or image corruption observed.

Pages 49-64: relative homotopy and the corrected pages 51-56 retain consistent layout, followed by homotopy and trivial-Kan sections. Equations and diagrams remain intact. The larger space before Section 30 on page 56 is normal paragraph/page stretching, not omitted content. No overview defect observed.

Pages 65-80: Kan and standard-resolution diagrams, horizontal strings of arrows and the two-column chapter list remain intact and within the text area. Page/heading styling stays consistent; no blank page, cutoff or diagram collision observed.

Page 81: final chapter-list continuation and bibliography are complete within their columns. The short final page is intentionally partially filled, not a blank or corrupted page. Header and final references are visible.

full_page_overview_inspections.inspection_scope: Complete page-layout overview, not word-by-word mathematical verification.

sheets.observation: Pages 1-16: contents, conventions, derived-category and induction sections have stable running heads, numbering and margins. Display equations and diagrams remain within the text body; the page-5 footnote and page-16 section transition fit. No blank, duplicate-looking, or clipped page was seen.

Pages 17-32: Mayer-Vietoris diagrams and exact-sequence displays on pages 18 and 24 remain visually separated from prose. The coherator and pseudo-coherent sections preserve normal page flow. The densely typeset pages 26 and 30 show intact lower margins. No gross overlap or missing page was seen.

Pages 33-48: approximation, generators, compact/perfect, module-category and base-change sections retain consistent text blocks and section hierarchy. Multi-line formulas and diagrams on pages 35, 38, 46-48 stay inside margins. All 16 pages contain distinct continuous content; no overview-level clipping was seen.

Pages 49-64: base-change, perfect pushforward, projection formula and limits sections retain clear whitespace around diagrams and displayed equations. Running headers and page numbers are regular. No blank page, shifted body, large overlap, or cut-off formula was seen at contact-sheet scale.

Pages 65-75: perfect complexes, applications, resolution property, boundedness and quasi-coherent-object sections flow consistently. The two-column chapter navigation on pages 73-75 and the final references remain within margins. The short final page is expected closing material, not a rendering omission. No gross layout defect was seen.

reader_facing_limitations.description: References to chapters outside the 36-chapter build profile can still display ?? placeholders. These are existing classified external-reference limitations, not missing glyphs or newly unclassified references. This receipt does not claim the PDFs are reference-complete.

reader_facing_limitations.disposition: Inherited official-source missing outer closing parenthesis, outside the 27 R48 operations. Separately recorded for deduplication and adjudication; not admitted or applied in this build.

claim_boundary: PASS means the stated rendered-page layout and correction-locus checks passed. It does not mean every theorem was newly proved or every inherited editorial defect was eliminated.
